verdict: Nike's revenue rose just 1% to $13.4B, but wider gross margins and flat overhead lifted net income 19% to $1.6B — even as it warned of a softer second half and announced a $2B cost-cutting plan.

takeaways.title: Growth was split by region
takeaways.text: Total revenue rose 1% to $13,388M: Asia Pacific & Latin America jumped 13% and Greater China 4%, while North America fell 4% and Converse fell 11%. NIKE Direct sales rose 6% to $5.7B; wholesale fell 2%.

takeaways.title: Margins did the heavy lifting
takeaways.text: Gross margin widened 170 basis points to 44.6% on higher prices and lower ocean freight costs, and inventories fell 14% to $8.0B. With overhead flat, net income rose 19% to $1,578M and EPS 21% to $1.03.

takeaways.title: A big cost-cutting plan is coming
takeaways.text: Nike announced a plan to find up to $2B of savings over three years — simpler product ranges, more automation, a leaner organization — and warned of pre-tax restructuring charges of about $400M to $450M, mostly severance, largely landing next quarter.
